description: Collect Kanto-area event data for the next 3 months and produce data/events.csv for the 「イベントボード」 dashboard's イベント tab. Use when the user asks to update, refresh, or regenerate the event dashboard data, run the weekly event collection, or rebuild events.csv. Also use when they invoke this by name or reference the weekly event-gathering routine. Walks the venue roster in data/spots.csv to re-verify every previously collected event (still running? extended? cancelled? price or coupon changed?) while discovering new ones in the same pass, searches beyond the roster for events at unregistered venues, compares prices across booking platforms (asoview!, Klook, KKday, VELTRA and others), detects active coupons and sales, records the cheapest legitimate booking link alongside the official site, and grows the venue roster itself as new places are found.
